title: Implementation Team Note on Signing and Go-Live of a PBM Services Agreement
content:
Go-live of a PBM Services Agreement is at least the pricing arrangement's implementation lead time, in calendar days, after signing. The funding arrangement and the expected employees are recorded at signing, and the sponsor's enrolled employees must meet the arrangement's entry threshold. Account management follows the arrangement's account management model, and claims data goes to the sponsor's vendors at the arrangement's claims data feed frequency.

## From signing to go-live

- At signing the agreement records the plan sponsor, the pricing arrangement, the funding arrangement of the sponsor's plan, the signing date, the agreed go-live date, the end of the initial term as the renewal date, and the employees expected at go-live. Its receivable and rebate balances start at 0.00.
- From signing until go-live the agreement is pending implementation.
- When the go-live date is reached the agreement becomes active and claims start adjudicating under it.

## Lead time — boundary illustration (hypothetical)

Signing on day 0 under a hypothetical lead time of 90 calendar days:

| Proposed go-live | At least 90 calendar days after signing |
|---|---|
| Day 89 | No |
| Day 90 | Yes |
| Day 120 | Yes |

## Entry threshold — points of judgement

- The test concerns the sponsor's enrolled employees measured against the threshold of the arrangement the sponsor is on, and the funding arrangement recorded at signing measured against the funding arrangements that arrangement accepts.
- *Hypothetical:* a self-funded sponsor with 300 enrolled employees, against an arrangement whose threshold is 250, meets the threshold; against an arrangement whose threshold is 500, it does not.

## Service model after go-live

The agreement is served under the arrangement's account management model (pooled, dedicated, or a dedicated team), and claims data is sent to the sponsor's vendors at the arrangement's frequency (monthly, weekly or daily).
